name: dogfood-llm-agent-orchestration-app
description: Dogfood app v1.38-4 — an Agent orchestration service that drives an LLM planning + tool-use + reflection surface backed by @kiwa/ai-llm v0.4 semantics (agent-orchestration ReAct / Tree-of-Thought / reflect-and-correct / tool selection + Vercel AI SDK provider mock), runnable in both KIWA_MODE=real (Vercel AI SDK + Anthropic Messages API when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + KIWA_LLM_BUDGET_USD are set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory state machine + tool ranker) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa/quality-metrics 11-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/ai-llm -F @kiwa/core -F @kiwa/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
